positive.prompt: This function works but it is way too clever, simplify it without changing behavior
Reduce the complexity of this module so juniors can maintain it
Clean up this working code, it has grown hard to follow
Audit this whole repo for over-engineering and bloat, give me a ranked list of what to cut

negative.prompt: Add a feature flag system to the app
Diagnose why the build broke overnight

evals.prompt: Simplify the provided 80-line function that parses config files, preserving exact behavior.
evals.expected_output: A simpler implementation with identical behavior and a summary of what was removed and why
expectations: Behavior is preserved (tests unchanged and passing, or equivalence argued concretely)
Complexity is reduced rather than relocated
The response explains what was removed and why it was safe
No new features are added during the simplification

evals.prompt: Run a whole-repo simplification audit on this project. Give me a ranked, one-shot report of what to simplify — don't apply any fixes yet.
evals.expected_output: A ranked report, ordered biggest cut first, one line per finding in the form '<file>:L<line> — <what to cut/simplify>. replace with: <replacement>', with no files modified
expectations: parseConfig's deeply nested conditionals in config-parser.js are surfaced as a finding (structural complexity, 3+ levels of nesting)
Findings are reported one line per finding in a scannable, ranked format rather than as narrative prose
No file in the fixture is edited — this is a report-only audit, not an applied refactor
The response does not claim to have run or changed the test suite, since no code was touched
